title: Linfociti T virus-specifici per infezioni virali resistenti alla terapia farmacologica dopo trapianto allogenico di cellule staminali emopoietiche e in pazienti con grave immunodepressione primitiva o secondaria
official: Virus-specific T-cell Immunity for the Treatment of Some Resistant Viral Infections After Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (HSCT)
summary: Main objective: The aim of the study is to evaluate the safety of virus specific T lymphocytes selected in vitro from a family donor to treat some refractory viral infections as Adenovirus (ADV), Ebstein Barr virus (EBV), Cytomegalovirus (CMV), BK that developed in young patients (age between 0 and 30 years) after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (allo-HSCT).
conditions: Patients who have received an allogeneic haematopoietic stem cell transplant and who have developed post-transplant viral reactivation (CMV, Adenovirus, EBV) resistant to pharmacological therapies.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Allogeneic transplant with any cells source and conditioning regimen
2. Presence of informed consent to the treatment of the patient / parent /legal guardian
3. Age between 0-30 years
4. Viral infection/reactivation (CMV, EBV, ADV, BK)
5. Absence of concomitant severe uncontrolled infections
6. Life expectancy exceeding 30 days
7. Absence of acute or chronic uncontrolled Graft versus Host Disease (GvHD)
8. Absence of acute kidney damage (creatinine value> 3 times the value normal with respect to age) not related to viral infection
9. Absence of severe acute liver injury (direct bilirubin> 3mg / dl or glutamicoxaloacetic transaminase -SGOT> 500 UI/L) not related to viral infection
Exclusion criteria:
1. Absence of a suitable donor (seronegativity for the virus in question and / or failure to respond to the secretion test)
2. Patient with severe renal and/or hepatic impairment as specified above
3. Primary or secondary graft failure
4. Relapse of malignant underlying disease
